newsitem.title: USA: Sonic sees Q4 charge of $0.39/shr.
newsitem.headline: Sonic sees Q4 charge of $0.39/shr.

text.p: Sonic Corp said Friday its fourth quarter ended August 31 will show a non-cash charge of $0.39 per share, primarily relating to the write-down of certain restaurants to fair market value, consistent with the earnings expectations of each restaurant using discounted estimated future cash flows.
The company said the charge was $8.5 million ($5.3 million, or $0.39 per share, on an after-tax basis).
Sonic said the charge is in accordance with a change in accounting standards.
The company said the write-down should result in a reduction in depreciation and amortization expense of about $800,000 ($500,000, or $0.04 per share, on an after-tax basis) for fiscal 1997.
It said it would report fourth quarter earnings on October 21.
The company also said that system-wide same-store sales increased 9.3 percent for the fourth quarter and 5.1 percent for the fiscal year.
